title: The Last Sigil
author: Coral Dunmore
blurb: Wendell Vane, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
